Platform Engineer

LEVER_BODY_MARKER Globex is looking for a Platform Engineer to build the internal developer platform our product teams ship on every day. You will design self-service tooling, harden our CI and CD pipelines, and run the Kubernetes clusters that host hundreds of services in production.

What you will do

  • Own the golden paths for building, testing, and deploying services.
  • Improve cluster reliability, autoscaling, and cost efficiency.
  • Build observability into every layer with metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Partner with security to enforce least-privilege access across the fleet.

What we look for

  • Four or more years of platform, infrastructure, or SRE experience.
  • Strong Linux, networking, and container orchestration fundamentals.
  • Fluency in at least one of Go, Python, or Rust for tooling work.
  • A bias toward automation and a track record of reducing toil.
